description: Larger required lot area is scored as more restrictive.
Wider required lot is scored as more restrictive.
Larger combined building-envelope setback is scored as more restrictive.
Lower permitted story count is scored as more restrictive. The 3.0-3.5 story band was added to fill a gap in the source example rubric, which only specified <=2.5, 3, and >=4 stories.
A higher required green/open-area percentage is scored as more restrictive.
A more burdensome parking regulation form is scored as more restrictive.
A more restrictive housing-type permission pathway scores higher.
A more restrictive ADU pathway scores higher.
A more discretionary principal-use approval process scores higher.
